instructions: This is the user's personal subscription ledger. Amounts are given both in the original currency and converted to the base currency. "My spending" excludes proxy payments (paid on behalf of others), and for shared plans counts only my own share. If you're unsure what a subscription is called, search with list_subscriptions first. Every write tool supports dry_run — preview first, then apply.

error.readOnly: This token is read-only and can't change the ledger. Create a read-write token on the AI access page in Calends.
error.aiDisabled: AI access is turned off in Calends settings
error.badToken: Missing or invalid token. Create one on the AI access page in Calends and pass it as Authorization: Bearer <token>
error.needSub: subscription is required (subscription id or name)
error.subNotFound: No subscription matches “{q}”. Try searching with list_subscriptions first.
error.subAmbiguous: “{q}” matches {count} subscriptions. Specify one by id: {list}
error.duplicateSub: “{name}” already exists with the same start date. Pass force=true to create it anyway.
error.duplicatePayment: A charge of {amount} is already recorded on {date}. Pass allow_duplicate=true if it really was charged twice.
error.notShareOwner: “{name}” isn't a shared plan you organize
error.nothingToChange: Nothing to change: pass balance, top_up, name or region
error.personNotFound: No person matches “{q}”. Try list_people first.
error.personAmbiguous: “{q}” matches {count} people. Specify one by id: {list}
error.personNoItems: {name} isn't in any shared plan or proxy payment to record against
error.personItemsAmbiguous: {name} is in several — pass subscription to choose: {list}
error.stopBeforeStart: Stop date cannot precede the start date.
error.stopAfterPaidThrough: Stop date is after the paid-through date. Use non-renewal instead.
error.refundExceedsPaid: Total refunds cannot exceed the amount paid for this period.
error.refundCurrency: Refund currency must match the subscription currency. Use settled for the card refund.
error.subscriptionEnded: This subscription has already ended. Resubscribe with a new phase.
error.terminatedReactivate: A provider-terminated subscription cannot reactivate. Resubscribe using change_plan (resume / new phase).
error.needStop: A terminated subscription requires stop information.
error.invalidPaidThrough: Paid-through date must match the original billing period.
error.invalidStop: Stop information must match the last service day; only provider termination may include a reason.
error.invalidRefund: Refund amounts must be valid and stored as negative values.
error.refundBeforeStop: Refund date cannot precede the stop date.
error.paymentOutOfRange: Payment date {date} must be between the start date and today
error.invalidFirstPeriod: first_period must be prorate, full or free.
error.invalidTarget: Target is missing, ambiguous, duplicated or invalid. Read the current records and specify an exact id/index.
error.references: This item is still referenced. Supply migrate_to or remove these references first: {references}
error.staleRecord: This record changed since the preview. Read and preview again.
error.noCategory: Category not found or ambiguous: {q}. Options: {list}
